description: Bake Brownie Cookies With Me 🤎🍪 These were soooooo delish!!! This recipe is from the 100 Cookies Recipe Book, so excited to try all of the recipes 🤭🤎 #baking #cookie #recipe #brownie #foryoupage
transcript: Today I'm making these brownie cookies and I thought you could make them with me. This was my first time trying this recipe. My mum got me so many baking recipe books for Christmas and I just can't wait to try them all. These were also absolutely delicious and the recipe's so easy to follow. So you start off by mixing together 116 grams of plain flour and a teaspoon of baking powder given that mix. Then in a separate bowl you add three large eggs and 250 grams of granulated sugar and give this a whisk together. You also need to add in a teaspoon of salt at this point. The recipe does use a stand mixer but I'm just using my electric whisk and doing it this way. You can see it's doubled in colour and is really light and fluffy here. You then need a tablespoon of canola oil. I just use vegetable oil because it's all I had. I then gave this a whisk together. You then need to melt together 226 grams of dark chocolate and 70 grams of butter in a bowl. Then once that's done add in 25 grams of cocoa powder. Then you're going to add this into your egg and sugar mixture and give this a good whisk together until it's all fully combined and really chocolatey. Once that's done the recipe then tells you to add in your dry ingredients into this. It does say to use a stand mixer again but I'm just folding it together with a spatula. And then this is what your mixture will look like once you're done. I popped these onto a baking tray like this. I did a heat tablespoon I'd say of each cookie. The recipe says it should make about 16 cookies and that's exactly how many I got out of it by doing the heat tablespoon. These then go into the oven for 8 to 12 minutes at 180 degrees celsius and the recipe says to bake one tray in the oven at a time and that's what I did and this is how they turned out. Honestly it's so perfect. Look at the crackle on top. Let me know if you give them a go.
